title: compress-result
description: Output of `orch conduct prune --compress-older-than DAYS --json`: the runs whose raw streams (<run>/**/streams/*.jsonl|.txt|.stderr|.times) were packed into .gz, or would be without --apply.

apply.description: True when the streams were packed, false for a dry run.

runs.description: One row per run old enough whose streams are not packed yet, in run id order.

status.description: Status of the run (one that prune may remove).

age_days.description: Days since the last journal line of the run.

compressed.description: Paths relative to the project: the .gz files written (apply) or the stream files that would be packed (dry run).

bytes_before.description: Size of the stream files before packing.

bytes_after.description: Size of the packed files plus the files left as they were; null for a dry run or a skipped run.

reason.description: Why the run, or a file of it, was left as it was (a busy lease, no longer eligible, a file that could not be packed).
